caseName: Toledo Pressed Steel Co. v. Standard Parts, Inc.
caseNameFull: Toledo Pressed Steel Co. v. Standard Parts, Inc. and Same v. Huebner Supply Co.
attorneys: Mr. Wilber Owen for petitioner., Messrs. William P. Blair and Will Freeman for respondents.

opinions.text:
Motion to defer consideration of the application for writs of certiorari in these cases, and petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, denied.

Reported below: 93 F. 2d 336.
